Government pledged to stabilize essential food markets while protecting consumer interests.

middle_east_exports_up.headline: Bangladesh Exports to Middle East Surge 14.47% in July‑August Amid Conflicts
middle_east_exports_up.summary: Bangladesh's merchandise exports to the Middle East climbed to $158 million in July‑August, a 14.47% increase over the same period last fiscal year despite regional conflicts.
highlights: Export value reached $158 million, up from $138 million
Growth rate of 14.47% recorded for FY2026‑27
Gains occurred despite ongoing Middle East conflicts

spouse_lifetime_benefit_in_universal_pen.headline: Bangladesh Plans Lifetime Spouse Pensions and Health Insurance for Universal Scheme
spouse_lifetime_benefit_in_universal_pen.summary: The government will propose lifetime pensions for spouses of deceased pensioners and health insurance to boost participation in the Universal Pension Scheme.
highlights: Eligibility age may be lowered from 60 to 55
Only 379,920 people have enrolled, contributing Tk288.52 crore
Mandatory enrollment for private bank employees is under consideration

seek_uk_assistance_to_withdraw_eu_high_r.headline: Bangladesh urges UK to help lift EU high‑risk cargo label
seek_uk_assistance_to_withdraw_eu_high_r.summary: Bangladesh's civil aviation minister appealed to the UK for support in persuading the EU to drop its high‑risk cargo designation, citing increased costs and delays.
highlights: EU imposed HRCM status on Bangladesh in 2017, raising air cargo costs and processing times
Bangladesh installed Explosive Detection Systems at major airports to meet EU requirements
UK and Bangladesh discussed purchasing Airbus aircraft for Biman and potential UK investment in aviation

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/mirza-abbas-trave.headline: Mirza Abbas Travels to Malaysia for Routine Medical Check‑up
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/mirza-abbas-trave.summary: BNP standing committee member and prime minister’s adviser Mirza Abbas departs Dhaka on a Biman flight for a scheduled health check‑up in Malaysia.
highlights: Mirza Abbas left Dhaka at 11:45 am on a Biman flight
He previously received treatment in Singapore and Malaysia after a March health crisis
BNP urges public prayers for his speedy recovery

bangladesh_eu_fta_negotiations.headline: Bangladesh and EU Move Toward Formal Free Trade Agreement Talks
bangladesh_eu_fta_negotiations.summary: Bangladesh and the European Union discussed deepening trade and investment ties, aiming to launch formal negotiations for a bilateral free trade agreement.
highlights: EU Ambassador Michael Miller met State Minister Humaiun Kobir to discuss progress on the free trade agreement
Both sides praised the longstanding Bangladesh‑EU partnership and pledged continued cooperation on migration, aviation and

gas_supply_improvement_directive.headline: Bangladesh Boosts Gas Supply and Expands LNG Infrastructure After PM Directive
gas_supply_improvement_directive.summary: Following Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's order, gas flow has risen sharply and new drilling, LNG imports, and additional FSRUs aim to secure the nation’s energy future.
highlights: 150 new gas wells have been drilled, with another 150 planned.
Floating storage regasification units will increase from two to five, with a third slated before 2028.
In‑principle approval granted for importing 18 LNG cargoes directly from global suppliers.

boeing_14_aircraft_delivery_urgency.headline: Bangladesh urges Boeing to fast‑track delivery of 14 Biman aircraft
boeing_14_aircraft_delivery_urgency.summary: Bangladesh’s aviation minister pressed Boeing to speed up delivery of 14 planes, citing the need to boost Biman’s fleet and achieve FAA Category 1 status.
highlights: Minister M Rashiduzzaman Millat requested faster delivery during meeting with US Ambassador Brent T Christensen.
Bangladesh aims to launch direct Dhaka‑New York flights next year after obtaining FAA Category 1 certification.

republican_fundraising.headline: US Billionaires Rally to Fund Republican Election Campaign
republican_fundraising.summary: A group of prominent US billionaires is committing substantial financial resources to boost the Republican Party’s upcoming election efforts.
highlights: The donors include major figures such as Charles Koch and the late Sheldon Adelson’s estate
Collectively they pledge hundreds of millions of dollars for campaign advertising and voter outreach

fuel_import_tk12_5cr.headline: Bangladesh to Import Fuel Worth Tk12,537 crore from China and Indonesia
fuel_import_tk12_5cr.summary: The government approved a G2G deal to import refined fuel valued at Tk12,537 crore from China’s Unipec and PetroChina and Indonesia’s BSP by year‑end.
highlights: Cabinet Committee on Government Purchase gave final approval chaired by Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury.
An extra 695,000 tonnes of fuel oil was added to the September‑December import quota.
LNG cargo from QatarEnergy will be bought at JKM + $0.02 per MMBtu, cheaper than the existing Gunvor contract.

fertiliser_import_9_2l_tonnes.headline: Bangladesh approves 44 firms to import 9.2 lakh tonnes of fertiliser
fertiliser_import_9_2l_tonnes.summary: The cabinet approved private imports of 9.2 lakh tonnes of non‑urea fertiliser and an additional 1.55 lakh tonnes via government‑to‑government deals to meet domestic demand.
highlights: 19 firms will import 5 lakh tonnes of DAP at $938 per tonne, costing Tk 47 crore
14 firms will bring in 2.2 lakh tonnes of MOP at $399 per tonne, costing Tk 8.78 crore
Government‑to‑government imports include 35,000 tonnes of MOP from Russia, 80,000 tonnes of DAP from Morocco and 40,000 tonnes

market_recovery_moody_upgrade.headline: DSE Extends Recovery Streak as Moody's Outlook Upgrade Boosts Sentiment
market_recovery_moody_upgrade.summary: The DSEX index rose to 5,494 as investors chased undervalued stocks, aided by Moody's upgrade of Bangladesh's outlook to stable.
highlights: Turnover increased 10% to Tk556 crore, with 180 stocks advancing
Textile sector led turnover at 27.6%, while general insurance posted the steepest decline of 2.2%

us_china_ai_threats_rivalry.headline: US and China Clash Over AI Threat Management Policies
us_china_ai_threats_rivalry.summary: The United States and China diverge sharply on how to regulate artificial intelligence, with each nation prioritising different security concerns and enforcement mechanisms.
highlights: Washington pushes for strict export controls on advanced AI models
Beijing emphasizes sovereign data protection and domestic AI development

fed_rate_rise_advice.headline: Fed urged to raise rates despite Trump pressure, say leading economists
fed_rate_rise_advice.summary: Top economists argue the Federal Reserve must increase interest rates now to curb inflation, even if it opposes President Donald Trump's preferences.
highlights: The Federal Reserve is expected to hike rates in its upcoming meeting.
President Donald Trump has publicly urged the Fed to keep rates low.
Economists warn that delaying a rate rise could fuel further inflation.

solar_import_duty_reduction.headline: Bangladesh Cuts Solar Import Duty to 1% to Boost Renewable Projects
solar_import_duty_reduction.summary: The finance ministry’s Internal Resources Division announced a six‑month 1% duty on most solar equipment, waiving VAT and advance tax to lower project costs.
highlights: Import duty reduced from up to 64% to 1% for most solar components
VAT and 2% advance tax are waived for industrial solar imports
Measure aims to accelerate new power‑generation capacity and enhance energy security

gas_supply_pressure_issue.headline: Gas Pressure Improves in Chattogram but Remains Low Across Bangladesh Industries
gas_supply_pressure_issue.summary: Industrial gas pressure has risen in Chattogram, yet factories in Dhaka, Gazipur and other regions still receive only 2‑4 psi, far below approved levels.
highlights: Petrobangla reports overall gas flow back to pre‑crisis levels after the Maheshkhali LNG terminal fire.
Most factories receive 2‑4 psi versus the required 10‑15 psi, limiting production to 50‑60% capacity.
Chattogram factories report near‑normal supply, averaging about 5% less pressure than before the incident.

customs_seizure_engine_consignment.headline: Chattogram Customs Seizes 19 Engines and Dismantled Vehicles in Misdeclared Consignment
customs_seizure_engine_consignment.summary: Customs officials uncovered 19 used engines, assorted old parts and two dismantled vehicles hidden in a Japan‑imported shipment falsely declared as motor parts.
highlights: The shipment, declared under Bill of Entry No C-9766, was inspected after a tip‑off on 1 September.
Maitree Automobile imported the consignment while JP Express Ltd acted as the clearing agent.
Authorities cite significant revenue‑evasion risk and plan strict legal action.

sovereign_dollar_bond_issuance.headline: Bangladesh Plans First Sovereign Dollar Bond, Targeting Up to $1 Billion
sovereign_dollar_bond_issuance.summary: Bangladesh aims to issue its inaugural sovereign dollar bond by December, seeking $500 million to $1 billion to diversify financing and attract international investors.
highlights: The Alternative Financing Committee, led by Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury, will approve the bond’s size and terms.
Bangladesh is also evaluating Panda, Samurai, Dim Sum and Sukuk bonds as future foreign‑currency financing options.

polyester_production_21pct_local_demand.headline: Modern Syntex Now Supplies 21% of Bangladesh’s Polyester Demand
polyester_production_21pct_local_demand.summary: Modern Syntex’s integrated plant now meets about 21% of Bangladesh’s polyester needs, saving $60 million in foreign exchange and creating 120 new jobs.
highlights: Investment of Tk1,700 crore enabled local PET chip production
Annual export earnings reach $30 million from 161,000 tonnes shipped
Polyester demand in Bangladesh grows roughly 10% per year

ev_import_ban_shutdown.headline: Barvida shuts down showrooms protesting ban on reconditioned electric vehicles
ev_import_ban_shutdown.summary: Barvida ordered a nationwide showroom closure and halted vehicle registration, duties and port clearance to oppose the government's August ban on used and reconditioned EV imports.
highlights: Barvida members will display protest banners at their showrooms
The association warned of tougher actions if the ban remains

ft.com/content/fb8e1037-8c48-49d2-809e-9.headline: Trump’s Push to Influence the Federal Reserve Falls Short
ft.com/content/fb8e1037-8c48-49d2-809e-9.summary: Despite intense political pressure, the Federal Reserve maintained its policy stance, rejecting former President Trump’s attempts to sway interest‑rate decisions.
highlights: The Fed kept rates steady amid Trump’s public criticism of monetary policy
Trump’s allies urged a rate cut, but the central bank cited inflation concerns
Federal Reserve Chair emphasized independence from political interference

plans_12_m_investment_and_1_000_jobs_for.headline: Menzies Aviation to Invest $12 Million in Dhaka Airport’s Third Terminal
plans_12_m_investment_and_1_000_jobs_for.summary: Menzies Aviation plans a $12 million investment to operate the second passenger‑handling contract at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport’s new terminal, creating over 1,000 jobs.
highlights: The project could generate more than 4,500 indirect jobs across Bangladesh’s supply chain.
Menzies will establish a training academy and source uniforms locally, boosting the textile sector.

open_skies_policy_and_air_service_agreem.headline: Bangladesh and India Pursue Open‑Sky Policy and Air Service Agreement Revision
open_skies_policy_and_air_service_agreem.summary: Bangladesh’s civil aviation minister and India’s ambassador discussed adopting an open‑sky regime, revising the air services pact and waiving airspace fees to boost regional connectivity.
highlights: Open‑sky policy and Air Services Agreement revision are under discussion between the two nations
Both sides consider waiving airspace charges and deploying India’s STOL aircraft on Bangladeshi airstrips

pragati_scheme_extension_to_state_owned_.headline: Bangladesh expands pension coverage, sets 11.72% return for state workers
pragati_scheme_extension_to_state_owned_.summary: The National Pension Authority will enrol state‑owned firm employees without pensions into the Pragati scheme, raising the fund’s maximum return to 11.72% for 2025‑26.
highlights: Islamic pension option approved under the Universal Pension Scheme
Nominee age limit increased from 75 to 80 years
Mobile financial service fee raised to Tk25

corporate_shareholding_limit.headline: Bangladesh Bank Caps Corporate Shareholding in Banks to Net Worth
corporate_shareholding_limit.summary: Bangladesh Bank imposed new limits restricting corporate entities from holding bank shares exceeding their net worth and tightened rules for representative directors to boost transparency.
highlights: Corporate shareholders must keep bank shareholdings below their net‑worth based on acquisition cost, with a six‑month compliance
Nominee directors now need to be a managing director or director of the shareholder and hold at least 2% equity in a listed firm

corporate_ownership_rules_for_banks.headline: Bangladesh Bank Tightens Corporate Ownership Rules for Commercial Banks
corporate_ownership_rules_for_banks.summary: Bangladesh Bank's new circular limits corporate shareholdings to a company's net worth and tightens board nominee eligibility to boost transparency and depositor protection.
highlights: Companies cannot own bank shares exceeding their net worth
Shareholders must hold at least 2% in a listed public limited company or 20% in other firms to nominate a representative director
Firms exceeding the limit have six months to adjust their holdings

tk9_750_cr_power_dues_clearance.headline: PDB Requests Tk9,750 crore to Secure Power for Boro Irrigation
tk9_750_cr_power_dues_clearance.summary: The Bangladesh Power Development Board seeks urgent release of Tk9,750 crore in subsidies to pay power producers and keep electricity flowing for the critical Boro rice season.
highlights: Unpaid power dues risk electricity supply for irrigation of nearly 29% of pumps
El Niño could intensify drought, raising irrigation demand during Boro
Government aims to shift all irrigation pumps to solar power within five years

reopening_of_four_jute_mills_creating_15.headline: Abul Khair Group Revives Four Private Jute Mills, Creates 15,000 Jobs
reopening_of_four_jute_mills_creating_15.summary: Shah Agro Ltd, a sister concern of Abul Khair Group, reopened four closed jute mills in Faridpur and Kushtia, employing 15,000 workers and targeting 80,000 tonnes of exports.
highlights: The mills will use existing factory structures and machinery, avoiding new capital investment
Exports are already reaching Turkey, China and other overseas markets
The group aims for Tk15,000 crore in jute product exports by December 2026

dsex_climbs_above_5_500_for_third_consec.headline: DSEX Surpasses 5,500 Points as Market Rally Extends for Third Day
dsex_climbs_above_5_500_for_third_consec.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange index rose to 5,532, with turnover up 18% and broad‑based buying across textiles, insurance and banks boosting investor confidence.
highlights: Market breadth was positive, with 67% of stocks advancing.
Textile sector accounted for 26.3% of total turnover.

profit_rise_but_89_of_non_life_claims_re.headline: Bangladesh Non‑Life Insurers Profit Up but 89% Claims Unpaid
profit_rise_but_89_of_non_life_claims_re.summary: Despite higher Q1 profits driven by lower costs and marine business, non‑life insurers have settled only 11.3% of claims, leaving 89% unpaid.
highlights: Agent commissions were abolished on 1 January 2026, cutting operating expenses.
IDRA targets settling about Tk 7,000 crore in outstanding claims, focusing on seven weak insurers.

evt_19e2d8adda.headline: Jute sales may fetch Tk549cr in Rajshahi this season
